User package¶

User.apps module¶

AppConfig for the users app.

  • Sets a clear verbose name for the Django admin.

  • Uses BigAutoField for primary keys by default.

  • Provides a ready() hook where you can import signal handlers (e.g., to auto-create default groups/permissions or profile rows).

Manages the API calls for any operations related to the User

  2. Login User

  3. Logout User

  4. Update User Attribute
